# Synerax

> Synerax is a technology partner that delivers AI-powered applications, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, DevOps and digital transformation as scalable, secure, future-ready solutions.

## About

Synerax is a team of engineers, designers and AI specialists, founded and headquartered in Noida, India. Its mission is to make enterprise-grade technology accessible to every business, regardless of size or location. What started as a small development shop has grown into a full-service digital engineering company serving clients across 20+ countries, from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Cross-functional teams bring expertise in software engineering, artificial intelligence and cloud architecture to every engagement.

## Services

- [Web & Enterprise Applications](https://synerax.in/solutions/web-enterprise-applications): Custom web platforms and enterprise-grade applications, engineered to scale.
- [DevSecOps & FinOps](https://synerax.in/solutions/devsecops-finops): Secure automated delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code and cloud cost efficiency.
- [Agentic AI Solutions](https://synerax.in/solutions/agentic-ai): Autonomous LLM agents, custom LLM pipelines and retrieval over your own data.
- [Cloud Engineering & Migration](https://synerax.in/solutions/cloud-engineering-migration): Cloud architecture, wave-based migration and optimization on AWS, Azure and GCP.
- [Observability, SRE & Production Engineering](https://synerax.in/solutions/observability-sre): Metrics, logs and traces, SLOs with error budgets, incident response and on-call engineering.
- [Application Modernization](https://synerax.in/solutions/application-modernization): Legacy systems re-architected for the cloud era, without a big-bang rewrite.
- [IT Service Management (ITSM)](https://synerax.in/solutions/itsm): ITIL-aligned processes, service desk and SLA governance.
- [All solutions](https://synerax.in/solutions)

## Industries

- [Healthcare](https://synerax.in/industries/healthcare): Secure, compliant IT for healthcare and pharmaceutical operations.
- [Financial Services](https://synerax.in/industries/financial-services): High-availability, compliant IT for banks, fintech and insurance.
- [Retail & E-Commerce](https://synerax.in/industries/retail): E-commerce platforms, real-time inventory and AI personalisation.
- [Government](https://synerax.in/industries/government): Citizen-centric digital services and secure public-sector infrastructure.
- [Education & EdTech](https://synerax.in/industries/education): Scalable learning platforms and secure campus infrastructure.
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://synerax.in/industries/logistics): Real-time tracking, demand forecasting, warehouse automation and carrier integrations.

- [Apply Express](https://applyexpress.synerax.in): AI job autopilot for the US — tailored resumes and real applications.
